note: Charged-current two-pion production off deuterium in the threshold region at the ANL 12-ft bubble chamber (Day et al., Phys. Rev. D 28, 2714 (1983)). Absolute total cross sections sigma(E_nu) for the three exclusive CC two-pion channels: nu_mu n -> mu- p pi+ pi-, nu_mu p -> mu- p pi+ pi0, and nu_mu p -> mu- n pi+ pi+. These are the '_xsec' cross-section tables from the NUISANCE ANL/CC2pi directory; the accompanying weighted/unweighted momentum distributions in the same directories are event-shape histograms and are excluded. Target: bound nucleon in deuterium; values in 10^-41 cm^2.
provenance: Day:1983itd - ANL 12-ft CC two-pion production on deuterium near threshold; total cross sections sigma(E_nu) for the three exclusive channels (mu- p pi+ pi-, mu- p pi+ pi0, mu- n pi+ pi+) - from the NUISANCE data release
